request.tone: warm exploration and wonder against a tide clock; violence none, scariness mild, peril moderate
request.note: catalog book read blind; no request exists

pitch.hero: Maya, a girl exploring the sea caves below her aunt's lighthouse with her companion Biscuit
pitch.want: to find out what the three echoing caves hold before the tide comes back
pitch.obstacle: a tide due back in about an hour, rising water, slick ledges, tight squeezes and a sleeping bat roost
pitch.stake: being caught by the sea in the caves, or leaving a wonder undiscovered
pitch.ending_kind: ten discoveries (crystal, song, bell, lake, islet, starfish, shell, skylight, compass, coins) or a safe retreat

maya.name: Maya
maya.want: to discover what the echoing caves hide and get out before the tide
maya.voice: close third present; curious, careful, brave in measured steps, tide-aware

biscuit.name: Biscuit
biscuit.role: Maya's four-legged companion (species never named; tail, paws, barks)
biscuit.want: to sniff out every path and stay close to Maya
biscuit.voice: wordless: tail thumps, whines, barks, nose-first curiosity

aunt.name: Maya's aunt
aunt.role: keeper of the lighthouse; offstage guardian
aunt.want: Maya back from the cove before the tide turns

truth.question: What do the three echoing sea caves under the lighthouse hold, and can Maya reach it before the tide returns?
truth.statement: Each of the three cave mouths under the lighthouse leads to its own hidden wonders: the humming left cave to a crystal grotto, a singing chamber and a lost ship's bell; the dripping right cave to an underground lake and a hidden tide-pool; the whispering middle cave to a bat roost with a skylight to the meadow and a century-old smuggler's cache. Maya has about an hour before the sea comes back and seals every mouth, so every deeper step trades safety against discovery.

maya_at_sea_caves.text: Maya ducks under the lighthouse rocks into a cove of sea caves to explore.

biscuit_with_maya.text: Biscuit, Maya's four-legged companion with a tail, ears and paws, goes with her into the caves.

lighthouse_above_cove.text: A lighthouse stands on the rocks above the cove and its sea caves.

aunt_knows_plan.text: Maya's aunt knows Maya and Biscuit are exploring the cove until the tide turns.

tide_going_out.text: The tide is pulling back from the sea caves as Maya arrives.

tide_will_return.text: The tide will turn and come back in, closing the caves.

three_cave_mouths.text: Three dark openings in the cliff breathe cool air: one left, one right, one straight ahead.

left_mouth_hums.text: The left cave mouth hums, warm and low.

right_mouth_drips.text: The right cave mouth drips, slow and steady.

middle_mouth_whispers.text: Something almost whispers in the dark of the middle cave mouth.

one_hour_limit.text: Maya has about an hour before the sea comes back and seals every cave mouth shut.

maya_has_torch.text: Maya carries a torch and has it switched on.

maya_has_notebook.text: Maya keeps a notebook in her pocket.

tide_turning_now.text: The tide has turned and the sea is coming back into the caves.

maya_plans_return.text: Maya means to come back to the caves on another low tide.

reached_mouth_safe.text: Maya and Biscuit get back out of the caves safely through the cave mouth before the sea closes it.

evening_on_exit.text: Maya comes out of the caves into evening light over the sea.

town_home.text: Maya has a home town near the cove whose people will want to hear what she found.

museum_known.text: There is a museum that would care about what Maya finds in the caves.

rockpool_club.text: Maya belongs to a rockpool club back home.

left_tunnel_light.text: Past a bend in the narrow humming left tunnel a soft light glows.

paper_rustle.text: A faint rustle like wind through paper drifts back along the left tunnel.

left_fork_glitter.text: The humming tunnel splits; one way has a wall glittering with tiny specks.

left_fork_murmur.text: The other way at the humming tunnel's split, the hum grows warmer, like a voice murmuring.

glitter_is_quartz.text: The glittering specks are tiny bits of quartz in the stone.

slope_to_crack.text: Beyond the quartz wall the floor slopes down toward a narrow crack breathing cold air.

round_room.text: The sloping floor opens into a small, quiet round room.

blue_crack.text: A crack in the wall glows with soft blue light.

crack_squeezable.text: The glowing crack is narrow, but Maya could just squeeze through it sideways.

grotto_water_rising.text: Cold water is seeping in and pooling around Maya's boots by the glowing crack.

left_pool_retreat.text: Maya turns back from the glowing crack without going through it.

through_crack.text: Maya and Biscuit squeeze through the glowing crack.

shimmer_room_ahead.text: Past the crack a wide room shimmers with blue light.

crystal_grotto.text: The shimmering room is a grotto of glowing blue crystals.

loose_crystal.text: One loose crystal wobbles in its socket at Maya's eye level.

humming_archway.text: Deeper in the grotto a rounded archway hums with a low sound.

maya_has_crystal.text: Maya takes the loose glowing crystal and holds it.

unseen_passage_up.text: The crystal lights a low passage Maya had not seen before, curving up toward the lighthouse.

passage_seen_before.text: Maya had already seen the low passage that curves up toward the lighthouse.

stair_to_lighthouse_door.text: The crystal-lit stair ends at a little wooden door tucked behind the old lighthouse.

ribbed_shell_walls.text: Past the archway, smooth ribbed walls curve overhead like the inside of a great shell, shaped as if to carry sound.

ringing_chamber.text: The ribbed passage opens into a vast round chamber where every sound rings back layered like a choir.

chamber_sings_back.text: When Maya sings a note, the chamber sings it back to her, layered and shimmering.

keepers_knew_chamber.text: Maya thinks only the lighthouse keepers of long ago knew of the singing chamber.

murmur_is_ringing.text: The warm murmur is not wind but a low even ringing, like a bell struck far below.

chime_below.text: The ringing becomes a slow deep chime rising from a lit chamber below, where metal flashes.

rope_ladder.text: An old rope ladder, left by someone long ago, hangs down into the chiming chamber and holds firm.

time_short_tide_clock.text: The tide-clock in Maya's head warns her that time is short.

hum_turned_back.text: Maya does not climb down the rope ladder and turns back toward daylight.

descended_ladder.text: Maya climbs down the old rope ladder into the chiming chamber.

ships_bell.text: A huge old ship's bell, green with age, hangs from a stone arch, and drips make it ring.

bell_names_lost_ship.text: Letters cast in the bell's lip spell the name of a ship lost a hundred years ago.

lantern_and_rope.text: A rusted lantern and a coil of good rope sit on a dry ledge behind the bell.

lantern_candle_stub.text: The rusted lantern still holds a stub of old candle.

ship_name_copied.text: Maya copies the ship's name into her notebook.

maya_has_lantern_rope.text: Maya carries the old lantern and the coil of rope.

trickle_floor.text: A thin trickle of water runs along the floor of the cold, salty right passage.

right_colder.text: The right passage feels colder than the other tunnels and tastes of salt.

right_fork_lapping.text: Where the trickle splits, one way carries a slow hollow lapping sound.

right_fork_briny.text: The other way at the split, a sharp briny smell comes from a low, narrow side-tunnel.

pebble_cavern.text: The lapping way crosses wet pebbles into a space whose ceiling the torch cannot reach.

black_water_shelf.text: A rock shelf borders wide, still black water; the lapping is that water.

underground_lake.text: The black water is a vast underground lake.

shelf_weed_slick.text: The rocky shelf narrows and turns slick with green weed above the lake.

lake_pale_shore.text: The underground lake has a pale shore below the shelf.

lake_turned_back.text: Maya backs off the slippery shelf and does not go down to the lake.

on_lake_shore.text: Maya climbs down to the pale gravel shore of the underground lake.

dark_shape_shore.text: Something long and dark rests half out of the water on the gravel shore.

rowboat.text: The dark shape is an old wooden rowboat, cracked but whole.

glowing_shallows.text: Further along the shore the shallow water glows from beneath.

boat_has_oars.text: The rowboat's oars are still lashed inside it.

boat_floats.text: Once emptied of rainwater, the rowboat floats steady on the lake.

crossed_lake.text: Maya rows Biscuit across the hidden lake.

chimney_to_dunes.text: Across the lake a stone chimney lets in daylight and leads up to dune grass.

first_to_cross.text: Maya is sure they are the first people in a lifetime to cross the hidden lake.

glowing_shells.text: Thousands of tiny pale shells glow on the bottom of the shallows.

white_islet.text: The glowing shells lead to a tiny islet of white sand lit by a shaft of sky.

maya_has_shells.text: Maya pockets a few pale shells to take home.

islet_secret.text: Maya promises to keep the glowing islet a secret.

biscuit_small.text: Biscuit is small enough to trot where Maya must crawl.

pool_pale_light.text: A paler light glows ahead through the briny side-tunnel.

clear_channel.text: The side-tunnel widens; weed hangs from the ceiling and a channel of clear seawater runs toward a rounded chamber.

weed_curtain.text: The channel ends at a curtain of hanging weed with bright watery light beyond.

channel_filling.text: Behind Maya the channel is filling fast with the tide.

pool_turned_back.text: Maya hurries back without going through the weed curtain.

hidden_tide_pool.text: Beyond the weed curtain lies a bright hidden tide-pool lit by sunlight from above.

anemones_fish.text: Anemones cling to the tide-pool's edges and small silver fish dart in it.

orange_starfish.text: A rare cushion starfish glows deep orange in a corner of the tide-pool.

starfish_new_to_maya.text: Maya has never seen anything like the orange starfish before.

starfish_seen_before.text: Maya has seen a starfish like the orange cushion starfish before.

crab_tracks_basin.text: Small crab tracks lead to a deeper, darker basin in the rock.

starfish_sketched.text: Maya sketches the orange starfish in her notebook.

starfish_left.text: Maya leaves the starfish where it clings to the rock.

starfish_taken.text: Maya takes the orange starfish with her.

club_doubt.text: The rockpool club will not believe Maya until they see her sketch.

pale_thing_basin.text: Something smooth and pale gleams half-buried at the bottom of the green basin.

spiral_shell.text: Maya lifts out a perfect spiral shell as big as her two hands, pink inside.

finest_find.text: The spiral shell is the finest thing Maya has ever found.

whisper_is_draft.text: The whispering echo is only a draft of air sighing over cold stone.

dark_fork_sounds.text: The dark passage forks: a papery squeaking and flutter one way, the creak of old wood and a glint of rusted iron the other.

hanging_shapes.text: Hundreds of small folded shapes hang twitching from a high ceiling.

bat_roost.text: The shapes are hundreds of sleeping bats roosting in a warm vaulted chamber.

grey_light_roof.text: A faint circle of grey light shows through a narrow shaft in the roost's roof.

must_not_touch_bats.text: The bats are wild animals, and Maya knows she must never touch them.

bats_not_woken.text: The bats sleep on and are not woken.

bat_turned_back.text: Maya backs away from the roost without crossing under the bats.

crossed_under_bats.text: Maya and Biscuit cross the floor beneath the sleeping bats.

bats_hunt_at_night.text: The roost wakes and pours into the night sky to hunt.

rock_stair.text: Under the grey shaft, fallen rock forms a rough stair climbing toward daylight.

old_carving.text: Halfway up the stair, an old carved arrow and faded initials show someone climbed it long before.

mossy_funnel.text: The stair narrows into a damp mossy funnel smelling of grass.

meadow_hole.text: The funnel comes out through a hidden hole in the clifftop meadow above the lighthouse.

bats_unnoticed.text: Nobody in years seems to have noticed the bat colony below the meadow.

door_in_side_cave.text: Broken barrel staves lie on the floor and a leaning door of grey planks with rusted nails is wedged into a side-cave.

walled_hollow.text: Behind the door is a dry hollow, walled off by hand long ago as a hiding place, with stacked crates.

smuggler_cache.text: The hollow is an old smuggler's cache, forgotten for a hundred years.

cache_floor_wet.text: Creeping water already glistens on the floor of the cache.

cache_turned_back.text: Maya leaves the cache without stepping inside.

cache_entered.text: Maya steps inside the smuggler's cache.

two_dry_boxes.text: Most crates have rotted, but two smaller boxes sit whole on a dry stone shelf.

compass_in_box.text: The first box holds a green-crusted brass compass.

coin_box_rattles.text: The second box is heavier and rattles like loose coins.

carry_one_box.text: Maya can only carry one box out cleanly before the tide catches up.

took_both_boxes.text: Maya carries both boxes out of the cache.

took_coins.text: Maya takes the heavy box of coins.

compass_true.text: The compass needle still swings true.

compass_guides_out.text: Maya follows the compass out of the caves.

biscuit_leads_out.text: Biscuit leads the way out to the cave mouth while Maya follows him.

silver_coins.text: The heavy box is full of blackened old silver coins stamped with strange faces.

coins_uncounted.text: Maya does not stop to count the coins.

n_open.event: Maya and Biscuit slip into the cove below the lighthouse at falling tide and face three cave mouths, each with its own sound.

n_start.event: Maya notes she has about an hour before the sea seals the caves, checks torch and notebook, and picks a sound to follow.

la_tunnel.event: The left passage narrows into a humming tunnel with a soft light and a paper-like rustle past a bend.

la_fork.event: The humming tunnel splits between a glittering wall and a warmer murmur, and the tide forces a choice.

la_glitter.event: The glitter is quartz; the floor slopes down toward a narrow crack breathing cold air.

la_glitter2.event: The slope opens into a quiet round room where a crack glows blue.

la_grotto_app.event: The glowing crack is just wide enough to squeeze through, but cold water is rising around Maya's boots.

la_retreat_pool.event: Maya carries Biscuit back through rising water and reaches the cave mouth, promising to return next low tide.

la_squeeze.event: Maya and Biscuit squeeze through the crack toward a wide shimmering room.

la_grotto.event: The room is a grotto of glowing blue crystals with one loose crystal and a humming archway deeper in.

la_crystal_take.event: Maya eases the loose crystal free and its light reveals an unseen passage curving up toward the lighthouse.

la_crystal_out.event: The crystal lights a stair to a door behind the lighthouse; Maya steps out into evening holding a real cave crystal.

la_crystal_deeper.event: Through the archway the hum becomes a chord and ribbed shell-like walls seem built to carry sound.

la_song_app.event: The ribbed walls open into a vast round chamber where every sound echoes like a choir.

la_song.event: Maya sings a note and the chamber sings it back; she has found a secret of the long-ago lighthouse keepers.

la_hum.event: The warm murmur turns out to be a ringing like a bell struck far below.

la_hum2.event: The passage steepens toward a lit chamber below where something metal chimes and flashes.

la_bell_app.event: An old rope ladder leads down to the chime, but Maya's tide-clock says time is short.

la_hum_back.event: Maya leaves the ladder and climbs back to the cave mouth safely as the sea begins to lap at it, planning her next visit.

la_bell.event: At the bottom of the ladder hangs a huge green ship's bell rung by drips.

la_bell2.event: The bell bears the name of a ship lost a hundred years ago; a lantern and rope sit on a ledge behind it.

la_bell3.event: Maya copies the ship's name into her notebook and gathers the lantern and rope.

la_bell4.event: Maya climbs out at evening with the ship's name, the lantern and the rope, picturing the town hearing of the lost ship's bell.

ra_drip.event: The right passage is cold and salty, with a trickle of water leading deeper.

ra_fork.event: The trickle reaches a split between a hollow lapping and a briny side-tunnel.

ra_lake_way.event: The lapping way crosses wet pebbles into a huge dark space.

ra_lake2.event: A rock shelf borders wide black still water, the source of the lapping.

ra_lake_app.event: The shelf narrows and turns weed-slick above a vast underground lake; climb down to its pale shore or back off.

ra_lake_back.event: Maya coaxes Biscuit off the slick shelf and retraces the passage safely, leaving the lake for another day.

ra_descend.event: Maya climbs down to the pale gravel shore and sees a long dark shape half out of the water.

ra_lakeshore.event: The shape is an old rowboat; further along, the shallows glow.

ra_boat.event: The rowboat still has its oars and floats once emptied; Biscuit hops in.

ra_row.event: Maya rows across the hidden lake and climbs a daylight chimney into the dunes.

ra_wade.event: Maya wades into shallows where tiny glowing shells lead toward a bright opening.

ra_islet.event: The shells lead to a sunlit islet of white sand; Maya pockets a few and vows to keep the place secret.

ra_pool_way.event: Maya crawls through the tight briny side-tunnel behind Biscuit toward a paler light.

ra_pool2.event: The tunnel widens under hanging weed and a clear seawater channel runs ahead.

ra_pool_app.event: The channel ends at a weed curtain with light beyond, while the tide fills the channel behind.

ra_pool_back.event: Maya carries Biscuit back through the filling channel and bursts out as the sea pours in, planning another try.

ra_pool_enter.event: Beyond the weed lies a bright hidden tide-pool with anemones and silver fish.

ra_pool_chamber.event: A rare orange starfish glows in one corner; crab tracks lead to a darker basin.

ra_starfish.event: Maya sketches the starfish in her notebook, leaves it in place, and slips out.

ra_starfish2.event: Maya leaves with notebook pages of starfish drawings the rockpool club will have to see to believe.

ra_pool_deep.event: In the green basin something pale gleams half-buried, and Maya reaches in.

ra_pool_deep2.event: Maya lifts out a great pink spiral shell, the finest thing she has ever found.

da_dark.event: The middle passage leads down; the whisper is only a draft over stone.

da_fork.event: The dark passage forks toward a squeaking flutter or a creak of old wood and rusted iron.

da_bat_way.event: Under a high ceiling hang hundreds of small twitching shapes.

da_bat2.event: The shapes are a sleeping bat roost in a warm vaulted chamber with grey light high in the roof.

da_bat_app.event: Reaching the grey shaft means passing under the roost; Maya knows never to touch wild bats.

da_bat_back.event: Maya leaves the bats sleeping and returns safely, glad of her kind choice and meaning to ask her aunt about them.

da_bat_enter.event: Maya and Biscuit cross hushed beneath the roost, no bat stirs, and a fallen-rock stair rises toward the light.

da_roost.event: Halfway up the stair Maya finds an old carved arrow and faded initials.

da_roost2.event: The stair narrows into a mossy funnel; Maya boosts Biscuit up and climbs toward green light.

da_skylight.event: Maya climbs out into the clifftop meadow through a hidden hole, a forgotten way into the caves above an unnoticed bat colony.

da_cache_way.event: Barrel staves and a leaning plank door with rusted nails mark a side-cave.

da_cache2.event: Behind the door is a hand-walled hiding hollow with stacked crates.

da_cache_app.event: It is a century-old smuggler's cache, but tide water is already creeping over its floor.

da_cache_back.event: Maya fixes the cache in memory and hurries out ahead of the tide, planning to return on a drier day.

da_cache_enter.event: Most crates have rotted, but two whole boxes sit on a dry shelf.

da_cache_room.event: One box holds a brass compass, the other rattles with coins; Maya can only carry one out before the tide.

da_compass.event: The compass needle still swings true; Biscuit leads Maya out fast ahead of the rising tide.

da_compass2.event: Biscuit leads Maya out just ahead of the sea, a true-pointing smuggler's compass in her hand.

da_coins.event: The box is full of blackened silver coins; Maya does not stop to count them and carries the box off.

da_coins2.event: Maya lugs the coin box out ahead of the tide and pictures the museum displaying the hoard with her name.

c_left.intent: explore the warm humming left cave
c_left.cost: gives up the right and middle caves

c_right.cost: gives up the left and middle caves

c_down.cost: gives up the left and right caves

c_hum.cost: gives up the glittering wall route

c_retreat.intent: turn back safely while the way is dry
c_retreat.cost: gives up the crystal grotto for today

c_take.cost: gives up the humming archway route

c_la_chord.intent: follow the chord toward its source

c_la_chime.intent: climb down toward the chiming light

c_la_bell4.intent: take the lantern and rope and head out

c_descend.cost: risks a fall into the cold lake

c_lakeback.cost: gives up the lake shore for today

c_ra_crouch.intent: crouch through toward the pale light

c_enter.cost: risks the channel flooding shut behind her

c_poolback.intent: hurry back before the channel fills
c_poolback.cost: gives up the hidden pool for today

c_deep.intent: follow the crab tracks to the dark basin

c_ra_sketch.intent: finish the sketch and slip out

c_bat.intent: go toward the squeaking and flutter
c_bat.cost: gives up the creaking wood route

c_da_creep.intent: creep on under the hanging shapes

c_da_grey.intent: move quietly toward the grey light

c_batback.intent: back away and let the bats sleep
c_batback.cost: gives up the grey shaft for today

c_da_climb.intent: climb on past the old carving

c_da_push.intent: push up through the mossy funnel

c_cacheenter.intent: step in for a quick look at the crates
c_cacheenter.cost: spends time as the tide rises

c_cacheback.intent: leave the cache and beat the tide
c_cacheback.cost: gives up the cache for today

c_compass.cost: gives up the box of coins

la_retreat_pool.gift: a safe, laughing escape from the rising water and a promise to come back for the glowing crack

la_crystal_out.gift: a real glowing cave crystal and a secret stair out behind the lighthouse

la_song.gift: a chamber that sings her own note back, a secret of the old lighthouse keepers

la_hum_back.gift: a safe return and a reason to come back for the chiming bell

la_bell4.gift: a lost ship's bell still ringing under the sea, its name in her notebook

ra_lake_back.gift: the good sense of backing off a slick ledge, with the black lake still waiting

ra_row.gift: a crossing of the hidden lake and a secret way up into the dunes

ra_islet.gift: a secret glowing islet and a pocketful of shining shells

ra_pool_back.gift: a thrilling race against the tide and a plan to try again

ra_starfish2.gift: a careful sketch of a rare starfish left where it lives

ra_pool_deep2.gift: a perfect pink spiral shell, the finest thing she has ever found

da_bat_back.gift: the kind choice to let wild bats sleep, and a question for her aunt

da_skylight.gift: a forgotten way into the caves and an unnoticed bat colony under the meadow

da_cache_back.gift: a smuggler's cache fixed in memory to come back for on a drier day

da_compass2.gift: a smuggler's compass that still points true and a story for the town

da_coins2.gift: a box of old smugglers' coins bound for the museum with her name

notes: The book declares no variables, so the plan has no threads; all 16 routes are a pure tree (walked with StoryEngine).
Label c_da_out says follow the compass out, while da_compass and da_compass2 say Biscuit leads and Maya follows him; both recorded as separate facts.
The middle mouth whispers straight ahead in n_open but the label c_down says straight down; recorded as the same middle mouth.
da_skylight and da_coins2 say the museum and ra_starfish2 says the rockpool club with no earlier introduction; recorded as required and established there.
